name: MiMo-V2.6 Harbor SWE
description: 48 terminal coding tasks in Harbor format (instruction.md + tests/ + solution/). Reward is the fraction of pytest cases passing after the agent's final command.

samples.prompt: Harbor task csv-dedupe — /app/data/users.csv contains duplicate rows that differ only by surrounding whitespace and email case. Write /app/dedupe.py that writes a canonical, deduplicated /app/users.clean.csv. Tests run your script, then check the row count and a few sample rows.
Harbor task implement-lru-cache — implement LRUCache(capacity) in /app/lru.py with get/put in O(1). Tests exercise eviction order and capacity 1 edge cases.
Harbor task parse-nginx-logs — /app/access.log is 2.1 GB of nginx combined-format logs. Write /app/top_ips.py that prints the 10 most frequent client IPs with counts, sorted descending.
Harbor task fix-flaky-retry — /app/client.py retries HTTP calls but tests fail intermittently. Find and fix the bug without changing the public API.
Harbor task cron-parser — write /app/cron.py that expands a 5-field cron expression into the next 5 run times after a given ISO timestamp. Tests check against fixed expected timestamps.
Harbor task jwt-verify — implement verify(token, secret) in /app/jwt_verify.py for HS256. Must reject alg=none and expired tokens.

objective.summary: Resolve the task in instruction.md so the hidden pytest suite passes. The fix must implement the behaviour; reproducing expected outputs is not a solution.
constraints: Tests are not to be modified
Must run inside the container's CPU and memory limits
No network access is required to solve any task

initial_state.summary: A per-task Docker container built from environment/Dockerfile, with the repository checked out at /app.

visible: stdout and stderr of its own commands
Anything readable from the container filesystem
hidden: Expected outputs in tests/ (intended, but reachable — see findings)
Reference solve.sh per task (intended, but shipped in the image)
Grader verdict until the episode ends

actions.description: Signal that the task is complete

evaluation.summary: Fraction of pytest cases passing after the final command, computed by the verifier container.
evaluation.audit: Held-out input variant re-graded with the same solution (added by the audit).

episode.termination: Agent signals done, or the command budget is exhausted
